title: Event
description: One point in space and time, or a long process with an interval and usually no place. An event points at a place record rather than repeating its coordinates; region is derived at index time from that place, and on the record it is an optional override, required when there is no place. `where` is the shape events carried before places existed and is accepted only while the migration runs (tools/migrate-places.mjs); it is removed the moment every event references a place.

where.description: Transitional. Replaced by `place`; see the description above.

place.description: The place record this event happened at, or null for a process with no honest point, which is then timeline-only and must carry a region.

actors.description: The actors of this event and what each did in it — not everyone alive. Roles are free text for now; build-index.mjs emits the set in use so a closed vocabulary can be decided later. That every actor resolves is rule 14.
